title: How to Write Your About Page, Without the “Writing About Myself”-Creeps — Little Flame Creative — Website Copywriter for Entrepreneurs

facts.fact: The Little Flame Creative blog post 'How to Write Your About Page, Without the "Writing About Myself"-Creeps' is written by Erica Hartwick and is categorized under Branding and Copywriting.
The post is dated February 3 but the page text does not state a year.
The author states there are three reasons why About pages are their favorite part of copywriting work.
facts.quote: Here are three reasons why About pages are actually my fave:

facts.fact: The author argues that the About page is not really about the writer's own life story but about how the writer is the right person to help their audience.
